These changes add one trainable scalar per item to both training scores and candidate scores, allowing item-wide preferences to be learned separately from contextual compatibility. Explicit zero initialization consumes no random initialization draws and preserves initial scores. Squeezing only the final dimension preserves output shapes. Padding bias remains zero under the unchanged host Adam optimizer because it starts at zero and padding_idx=0 suppresses its embedding gradients.

All existing architecture, interfaces, variable names, imports, constants, and host behavior remain unchanged. This defines one candidate for host evaluation against validation HR@10=0.635; 0.645 remains an unmeasured target.
